title: 3 Years Later, Netflix’s Best Anime Comedy Returns With a New Release Amid Delay
content: The anime industry has grown significantly over the years, even to the point of competing with mainstream media. As the popularity of the anime and manga industries grows rapidly, hundreds of series and films are released each year.
author: ComicBook

title: 20 Years Later, Acclaimed Classic Confirms Surprise Anime Revival
content: The anime and manga industry is heavily dominated by the Shonen demographic, and most of the mainstream series are purely battle action. Most of the best-selling manga of all time are also Shonen series, including One Piece, Naruto, Dragon Ball, Demon Slayer, and more.
author: ComicBook

title: GungHo Announces Ninjala 2: The Uncharted Planet Game for Switch 2
content: GungHo announced during the " Nintendo Direct livestream" on Tuesday it is developing Ninjala 2: The Uncharted Planet , a sequel to its 2020 free-to-play online Switch game, for the Nintendo Switch 2 next spring. The Ninja Gum action of Ninjala is back, now with the series' first-ever open-world!
author: ANN

title: Hello Kitty Party Land Game Announced for Switch, Switch 2 on October 29
content: Bandai Namco announced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Tuesday that Hello Kitty Party Land , a new party game featuring Sanrio characters, will launch for the Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 on October 29.
author: ANN

title: Viz Media's Shonen Jump, Shueisha's Manga Plus Add Twilight Blade Manga
content: Manga creator Chiyoko Maruume and Tokegoro launched a new manga titled Twilight Blade ( Awai no Homura ) on Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ platform on Wednesday, with Maruume writing the story and Tokegoro drawing the art.
author: ANN

title: Will Retakes the Blooming Trial in Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2 Episode 10 Preview
content: Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2 has revealed the preview images and synopsis for Episode 10 (Episode 22 overall). In the previous episode, we got to see the past of Will and Elfaria . Crunchyroll is streaming the anime worldwide, with Episode 10 scheduled to premiere on June 14.
author: Anime Corner

title: GKIDS Screens The Last Blossom Film in U.S. Theaters on August 30-31
content: GKIDS announced on Tuesday it will screen Baku Kinoshita and writer Kadzuya Konomoto 's original anime film The Last Blossom ( Housenka ) in the west on August 30-31. GKIDS describes the story: Former yakuza Akutsu is serving life in prison after a middling career in the underworld.
author: ANN

title: Kaiji Gets New Live-Action Film in January 2027
content: TOHO Movies revealed in a early teaser trailer on Wednesday that Nobuyuki Fukumoto 's Kaiji manga will receive a new live-action movie adaptation titled Kaiji : Jinsei Revenge Game ( Kaiji : Life Revenge Game) on January 29.
author: ANN

title: Top 5 New Anime of 2026 So Far, Ranked
content: The Spring 2026 season is coming to an end, meaning nearly half the year is already behind us, along with many of the anime that debuted during it. So far, 2026 has delivered a strong mix of returning favorites and brand-new series across its first two seasons.
